subject: New Sign-in to Your USF Account
body:
Hello {{firstName}},
As part of our ongoing effort to keep your account secure, we're writing to let you know that we noticed a new sign-in to your USF NetID account.
Here are the details we have on file for this sign-in:
Account:{{email}}
Device:Windows PC
Browser:Chrome
Location:Tampa, FL
Time:9:14 AM
If this was you, there's nothing further you need to do. This message is simply part of our routine account monitoring, meant to help you keep track of where and when your account is being accessed.
If you don't recognize this sign-in, we recommend changing your password as soon as possible. You can do this through the official USF Account Management portal, where you can also review your recent sign-in history and update your recovery contact information. If you run into any trouble accessing your account or have questions about this notice, the OTS Help Desk is available to assist.
As a general reminder, we encourage all students to use a unique password for their USF account rather than reusing one from other sites, and to avoid signing in from public or shared computers whenever possible.
Thank you for helping us keep the USF community secure.
USF Office of Technology Services
